description: This file implements a non-blocking gRPC server for the Kubernetes kubelet plugin system, including server setup, context management, request handling, and graceful shutdown.

classes.name: grpcServer
classes.description: Represents a gRPC server with associated configuration, including endpoint, verbosity, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: mergeServerStream
classes.description: Wraps a grpc.ServerStream to override the Context method with a custom context.

classes.name: mergeCtx
classes.description: Custom context that merges a root context with a value context, used for context management in gRPC streams.

methods.name: startGRPCServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts a gRPC server on a Unix domain socket, with support for interceptors, services, and error handling.

methods.name: unaryContextInterceptor
methods.description: Creates a unary server interceptor that injects a specific context into each request.

methods.name: streamContextInterceptor
methods.description: Creates a stream server interceptor that injects a specific context into each stream.

methods.name: mergeContexts
methods.description: Creates a new context that combines a root context and a value context, with cancellation handled by the root.

methods.name: interceptor (method of grpcServer)
methods.description: Handles each unary request, adding request ID and logging request/response details.

methods.name: streamInterceptor (method of grpcServer)
methods.description: Handles stream requests, adding request ID, context, and logging stream activity.

methods.name: stop (method of grpcServer)
methods.description: Gracefully stops the gRPC server and waits for ongoing requests to complete.
